name: ʻŌhiʻa lehua
desc: A native tree whose flowers give nectar to honeycreepers. It grows in many Hawaiian forests and is a foundation of the native forest.
about: Metrosideros polymorpha, the ʻōhiʻa lehua, is a species of flowering evergreen tree in the myrtle family, Myrtaceae, that is endemic to the six largest islands of Hawaiʻi.
